benefits.name: Dining Credit
benefits.description: Monthly statement credit for eligible purchases at restaurants worldwide.
benefits.terms: Up to $25/month ($300/year total). Unused monthly amounts do not roll over.

benefits.name: Marriott Bonvoy Property Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for qualifying stays at The Ritz-Carlton or St. Regis properties.
benefits.terms: $100 property credit toward eligible incidentals on qualifying stays of two nights or more at The Ritz-Carlton or St. Regis.

benefits.name: Annual Free Night Award
benefits.description: A Free Night Award (redeemable at properties valued at or under 85,000 Marriott Bonvoy points) granted each year after card renewal.
benefits.terms: Granted automatically each year after the card renewal month. Redeemable at participating hotels at or under an 85,000-point redemption level (plus any required cash co-pay for higher-value stays).

benefits.name: Global Entry or TSA PreCheck Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for a Global Entry (every 4 years) or TSA PreCheck application fee.
benefits.terms: Up to $120 for Global Entry (renews on its own ~4-year cycle) or up to $85 for TSA PreCheck (5-year cycle).

benefits.name: Priority Pass Select Membership
benefits.description: Complimentary Priority Pass Select membership with unlimited visits to over 1,300 airport lounges worldwide.

loungeAccessDetail.guestPolicy: Unlimited visits for the primary cardholder; guest policy varies by lounge.

benefits.terms: Requires enrollment through the American Express account.

benefits.name: Marriott Bonvoy Platinum Elite Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Platinum Elite status.
benefits.terms: Automatic upon card membership by linking a Marriott Bonvoy account.

benefits.name: Elite Night Credits
benefits.description: Elite Night Credits toward the next level of Marriott Bonvoy Elite status, granted each calendar year.
benefits.terms: 25 Elite Night Credits per calendar year.

earningRates.terms: Eligible purchases at hotels participating in Marriott Bonvoy.
Restaurants worldwide and flights booked directly with airlines.
